url.description: The URL that was tested (https:// added if it was missing)

status.description: ok = the test finished, error = it did not (see error). Error rows are not charged

error.description: Plain reason when status is error (bad key or URL, API not enabled for the key, quota exceeded, Lighthouse error); null otherwise

scores.description: Lighthouse category scores 0-100, for example {"performance": 87}; empty object on error

labMetrics.description: Lab measurements: lcpMs, cls, tbtMs, fcpMs, speedIndexMs, ttiMs (null when Google did not report one); empty object on error

fieldDataPresent.description: true when Google has real-user (Chrome UX Report) data for this exact URL

fieldData.description: Real-user Core Web Vitals for this URL: lcpMs, inpMs, cls (each {value, category}) and overallCategory; null when there is no URL-level data

originFieldData.description: The same for the whole origin (site); null when Google has none
